name: ANSI/IEEE reactor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for reactor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The reactor form identifies an inductive component in the documented power circuit. Series or shunt connection establishes its placement, while the device schedule explains whether its intended duty concerns impedance, filtering or another application.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace the external connection before interpreting the inductive outline.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A reactor's winding is not an additional transformer secondary unless magnetic coupling is explicitly part of the device.
